title: F_p(z) derivation attempt in v3.1 cone depth picture (REVERTED)
summary: Initial calculation gave F_p(z) ~ 1, but this contradicts local DM observations. Reverted to honest 'cannot derive F_p from v3.1 framing'.

current_status.honest_conclusion: F_p(z) CANNOT be derived from v3.1 framing as currently written
current_status.reason: §3.67 f_back_4D = 1 is inconsistent with closed loop formula (gives 10^-75). The 'fully back-projected substrate' claim is ambiguous — what does f_back mean at the 4D-event level?
current_status.limitation_L137_NEW: §3.67 f_back_4D = 1 vs closed loop formula gives f_back_4D ~ 10^-75. Cannot both be right.

key_insight: The user caught that F_p = 1 (all primordial) is wrong because SIDC's whole point is that DM varies between galaxies based on local star formation history. F_p must allow for non-negligible cumulative contribution.
next_step: Need to clarify what f_back_4D means before any F_p derivation. Either f_back_4D = 1 (substrate fully projects) is misinterpreted, or the closed loop formula needs extension to the 4D event.
